title: Transitions, animation and motion, in the framework rather than a library

videos.script:
Svelte creates and destroys every element on the page, {{knows}} so it knows the exact moment each one arrives and leaves. That makes animation part of the framework.

First, transitions. {{slide}} Rows that slide in and out as the week changes. You will catch them halfway, while a leaving row is still on the page.

Then animate flip. {{flip}} A new session lands between two others, and the rows below it glide down instead of jumping.

Then a number that travels. {{tween}} The minutes done count up when you tick a session, and you will read the page four times on the way.

Then you write a transition of your own, {{custom}} in five lines, and choose how it spends its time.

And last, the part that is not optional. {{reduce}} Some people get ill from movement on a screen, and their computer says so. Svelte does not listen by itself. You will make every animation in the planner stop when asked, without losing anything it shows.
